more_info.overview: Synthetic calcium aluminates is a group name for materials made from calcium-oxide and aluminium-oxide components. Several calcium-to-aluminium compositions and crystalline phases are possible. A general chemical description therefore does not identify one commercial additive preparation. The exact material and technological food function covered by this historical designation were not confirmed. Industrial calcium-aluminate materials cannot be treated as evidence of a food-grade product.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
